description: The C3 financial-controls decision layer (gate 5, M3): the SoD invariant (approver ≠ raiser), value-tiered approval limits, dual control above the tenant's configurable threshold, and the supplier-identity change freeze with out-of-band verification. Pure and deterministic — the resolved principal, the tier config, the prior votes and the hold rows are always injected. Every invariant decided here is ENFORCED AGAIN at the database (the RESTRICTIVE sod_binding policy binds each decision to the app.actor_id GUC; the proposal_state_guard trigger requires the tier's votes; the supplier_identity_freeze trigger refuses any identity change without the verified hold) — the API+DB pair A4 demands, neither layer trusted alone. Refusals carry Class-D-shaped denial records; the durable ledger write lands with H5.
